seed.vulnerability_summary: A malicious USB device lacking expected endpoints causes NULL-deref or out-of-bounds read in cx231xx_init_v4l2 and cx231xx_usb_probe by accessing endpoint array without validating bNumEndpoints against the isoc_pipe index.
seed.vulnerability_pattern: USB driver accesses interface altsetting endpoint array using an assumed pipe index without first verifying bNumEndpoints exceeds that index, violating endpoint array bounds.
